title: Trump delays AI security executive order, saying language ‘could have been a blocker’
text: President Trump delayed signing an executive order that would have required pre-release government security reviews of AI models, citing dissatisfaction with the order's language.

title: The Path, founded by Tony Robbins and Calm alums, hopes to offer safer AI therapy
text: The Path says its AI model has scored 95 on the mental health safety AI benchmark, Vera-MH. This compares to a top score of 65 for the consumer bots.
